title: Sparkly submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- submarine body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='28' ry='14' fill='#f4a020'/>

  <rect x='40' y='34' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd060'/>

  <rect x='22' y='52' width='4' height='8' rx='1' fill='#e09018'/>
